title: Integral localization commutes with ordinary qcqs pushforward
statement: For a prime ℓ, normed extension E/Q_ℓ, qcqs f:X→Y and any integral module M on X, the specified coefficient-change/pushforward mate Ext_Y(f_*M)→f_*(Ext_X M) is invertible, with coefficients as in [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients].

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), degree-zero filtered continuity and scalar localization; agent categorical consequence

proof.text: Present both restricted extensions by their module localization-unit telescopes. Reindex the scalar telescope to match pushforward. Ordinary qcqs continuity preserves this filtered colimit (lift the natural-number index universe before applying the stated continuity theorem).

Restrict the specified mate and compose with the restriction/pushforward comparison. Reuse the already proved generic mate_unit_comap and localization_comparison_zero helpers of ContinuousIntegralPushComparison. They identify the zeroth telescope leg with the pushed unit; invertibility of ℓ identifies every leg. Uniqueness of colimits makes the composite invertible. Cancel the comparison isomorphism and reflect isomorphisms through faithful restriction.
